title: Cross-host evidence bare-root dependency edge
description: Objective: give the repository fault-evidence consumer a real, lockfile-backed bare-specifier edge to the public @moe/runner platform surface and @moe/daemon doctor collector before cross-host acceptance code imports either. Deliverable: root manifest/lock importer entries plus one durable fault-lane public-surface call site. NOT in scope: host schedules, receipt aggregation, workflow execution, or adding deep-relative fallbacks. Hard dependency: task-f6ef0a45f52c45c7bb54f250170aa223 must be DONE so the call site can import collectDoctorVersionReport from the public daemon root. Current gap at HEAD 26ac640/8d9afb8: root package.json declares neither workspace package, the root pnpm importer carries neither, and `node --input-type=module -e "import('@moe/runner')"` from the repository root fails ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND. Consumer: task-01c5f96ec1e247dc846fd628c929974a. Owned paths: package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, tests/fault/cross-host/production-surfaces.fault.ts. pnpm-lock.yaml currently has foreign WIP; do not begin until its owner commits and the path is clean. Verification: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec tsc -p tests/fault/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec vitest run --config tests/fault/vitest.config.ts cross-host/production-surfaces.fault.ts.
definitionOfDone: Root package.json declares @moe/runner and @moe/daemon in dependencies at workspace:* and pnpm-lock.yaml carries matching root-importer links.

A durable fault-lane call site imports PLATFORM_BOUNDARIES, both OS observation entrypoints, and collectDoctorVersionReport from the two bare package specifiers; it contains no deep-relative package import.

A compiled in-root probe and a plain-Node root probe both exit 0, observe the exact seven nonempty boundary names, both OS callables, and the callable doctor collector, and are deleted/no scratch bytes remain.
The public-surface fault test asserts the hand-written symbol set/cardinality so a missing import or zero-case catalogue cannot pass, and names task-01c5f96ec1e247dc846fd628c929974a as its consumer.
Fresh frozen install, fault-lane typecheck, and the focused public-surface test exit 0.
taskRails: Do not start before task-f6ef0a45f52c45c7bb54f250170aa223 is DONE and package.json/pnpm-lock.yaml are free of foreign WIP.
No deep imports, tsconfig paths, project-reference workaround, or subprocess cwd trick may replace the manifest+lock+compiled bare-specifier proof.
Preserve the root test script set, use TDD, and stage only the three explicit owned paths.
blockedReason: The task's literal hard dependency is still unmet: task-f6ef0a45f52c45c7bb54f250170aa223 is PLANNING and held by another architect, not DONE. Fresh HEAD 18f0964 shows package.json/pnpm-lock and daemon root paths clean, but repository-root bare probes for both @moe/runner and @moe/daemon still fail ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND, and the doctor collector therefore cannot yet be named from the public daemon root. Planning the durable call site before f6ef lands would either reference an absent root export or weaken the call site. Resume after f6ef is DONE, then remeasure its bare export and the clean shared manifest/lock paths.

priorHandoffs.whatRemains: After f6ef is DONE, re-probe @moe/daemon.collectDoctorVersionReport, verify manifest/lock paths are clean, then submit the three-file dependency-edge plan.
